cases.name: Erika Zamorano
cases.about: Her obituary said Erika enjoyed life to the fullest and loved being a mother to her children. Her kids meant the world to her. She always dreamed of going to the beach and furthering her education.

cases.name: Elisa Aleman
cases.about: Elisa was born in Delicias, Mexico and came to the U.S. in the early 1990's. She was a wife and devoted mother and grandmother.  Family was very important to her, and she always made herself available to any of them who needed her.  For enjoyment she liked to dance
